feed.title: Open Tools and Research — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1307 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Changepoint Detector — find when a time series changed (PELT + Bayesian)
entry.summary: Free changepoint detection for any time series. Paste a CSV and see when the level or volatility changed, with exact PELT segmentation and Bayesian online changepoint probabilities (Adams & MacKay 2007; Killick et al. 2012). Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Conformal Prediction Intervals Calculator — distribution-free prediction intervals online
entry.summary: Free conformal prediction intervals calculator. Paste a CSV, pick the column to predict and a coverage level, and get distribution-free prediction intervals with a finite-sample guarantee: split conformal, locally weighted conformal and conformalized quantile regression (CQR), checked on held-out rows. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: CSV to SEPA Payment File (pain.001) — Free Bulk Credit Transfer Converter
entry.summary: Free CSV to SEPA converter: turn a spreadsheet of supplier or payroll payments into a pain.001 XML file for your bank's bulk upload. Checks every IBAN and amount first, writes exact control totals, and never uploads your list.

entry.title: CSV to SEPA Direct Debit File (pain.008) — Free Mandate Collection Converter
entry.summary: Free CSV to SEPA direct debit converter: turn a spreadsheet of member or customer collections into a pain.008 XML file for your bank. Checks every IBAN, mandate and your creditor identifier first, groups FRST/RCUR/OOFF/FNAL batches, and never uploads your list.

entry.title: Hearth & Horizon: free AI-written science fiction and Catholic bedtime stories, with audio
entry.summary: Free short science fiction about the next thousand years, stories written for AI agents, and Catholic bedtime stories about the saints. Read or listen; podcast RSS feeds; CC BY-SA 4.0.

entry.title: Interview to Content Calendar: Posts for Every Platform (Free)
entry.summary: Answer one guided interview about your brand or topic and get a 4-week content calendar with drafts for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, newsletters, blogs and more. Free, runs in your browser, optional AI on your own key.

entry.title: Matrix Profile Online — Find Repeated Patterns and Anomalies in a Time Series
entry.summary: Free matrix profile tool for time series anomaly detection and motif discovery. Paste or upload a CSV and find repeated patterns (motifs) and the most unusual stretches (discords) with the exact STOMP algorithm. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Personality Conversation Simulator: Fictional Characters (Free)
entry.summary: Build fictional characters with Big Five personalities and simulate negotiations, team meetings and arguments between them. Free, private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Saints by Candlelight: a free bedtime podcast of saints, angels and Bible stories
entry.summary: Free bedtime story podcast of Catholic and Orthodox saints, angels and patriarchs: lighthearted, faithful, 30 to 60 minute episodes with full scripts and an honest note on what is history and what is legend.

entry.title: Sales Cadence Builder — plan email, call, LinkedIn and letter outreach, free
entry.summary: Free sales cadence builder and outreach sequence planner. Paste your prospect list and get a multi-channel cadence (email, phone call with voicemail script, LinkedIn note, mailed letter) on business days, call times inside each prospect's local business hours, suppression and consent checks, and a CSV and calendar file. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Bid Price Engine — Job Bid Calculator for 120+ Trades, Margin Not Markup
entry.summary: Free job bid calculator for contractors and service trades: labor with payroll burden, materials with waste, subs, contingency and overhead turned into a price at the profit margin you choose. Shows your walk-away price and how far labor can overrun. Private, no signup.

entry.title: Discogs Fee Calculator — What You Keep After the 9% Fee and Processing
entry.summary: Free Discogs seller fee calculator: the 9% selling fee on item price plus shipping ($0.10 minimum, $150 maximum), editable payment processing, your payout and profit after postage and cost, the price that hits a target profit, and a fee ladder from $3 singles to $2,500 grails. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Hands-Free Language Coach — voice-only language practice while you drive or walk
entry.summary: Learn a language by voice alone: the coach says a phrase, you say it back, it listens and scores you, and moves on. No tapping, no screen. Streaks, XP and spaced review like a language game, free in your browser, plus a skill for Claude and ChatGPT voice mode.

entry.title: Listen & Learn Audio — bilingual audio stories for language learners, hands-free
entry.summary: Short graded stories read aloud in Spanish, French, German and Italian, each line followed by English. Press play and listen while you walk or commute. Free in your browser, plus an AI skill for Claude and ChatGPT voice mode that tells new stories and podcast-style episodes on any topic, at your level.

entry.title: Open Tennis Robots — open-source tennis ball machine with a catch net, and a ball pickup robot
entry.summary: Build your own tennis ball machine that catches your returns with a moving net, and a robot that picks up tennis balls while you practise. Open-source hardware designs, firmware and software (MIT), plus a shot simulator you can try in your browser.

entry.title: Tutoring Group Schedule Optimizer — which group sessions to run and who sits where
entry.summary: Free group schedule optimizer for tutoring centres, music, swim and language schools. Paste your possible weekly sessions and student availability to get the most profitable timetable. Exact for up to 10 slots. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: US Substantial Presence Test Calculator — 183-Day Weighted Count
entry.summary: Free calculator for the IRS substantial presence test: enter your days in the US and see the 183-day weighted count (this year + a third of last year + a sixth of the year before), how many more days you can spend before you become a US tax resident, and when you crossed the line.

entry.title: Demand Forecast Back-Tester — safety stock and reorder points from your sales
entry.summary: Free demand forecasting for small sellers. Upload a sales CSV to get a back-tested forecast per SKU, safety stock and reorder points at your service level, ABC-XYZ classes, and an honest check of whether the forecast beats repeating last month. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Grailed Fee Calculator — What You Keep After the New 6% / 9% Commission
entry.summary: Free Grailed seller fee calculator for the tiered commission (6% under $120 with a $1.99 minimum, 9% from $120) plus 3.49% + $0.49 payment processing. See your payout, profit, the price for a target profit, and the $120 step where the whole sale jumps to 9%. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Meeting Notes to Action Items Extractor (Free)
entry.summary: Paste meeting notes or a transcript and get action items with owner and due date, decisions and open questions, plus a follow-up email. Free, private, no upload.
